notes: Firmware 0.2.1 — the display self-repair (the permanent fix for the recurring System-Data-ERROR): a TFT delivery is not 'done' until the display PROVES it — the HMI's boot announcement (printh 88 ff ff ff) only fires when the flash content is valid. A delivery whose display never announces FAILS and the attempt loop power-cycles and re-delivers (the md5 record only happens after the proof). A display restart that finds no announcement detects the broken flash and auto-re-delivers the TFT (capped at 2 per boot). The System-Data-ERROR can no longer wait for a human. Carries all of 0.2.0.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
